assessment.state_like_structure: Partial local support: action-conditioned residual transition is learnable; reliable autonomous long-horizon propagation is not established.
assessment.closest_prespecified_case: B, with a material decoder reconstruction bottleneck
assessment.decoder_bottleneck: Teacher reconstruction normalized RMSE 0.078243 exceeds Direct K10 one-step 0.022245; high R2 does not imply precise readout.
assessment.latent_drift: Normalized latent RMSE rises from 0.044726 at H1 to 0.512454 at H50; cosine declines from 0.999391 to 0.936980.
assessment.observation_comparison: Explicit latent observation RMSE exceeds immutable Direct K10 at every tested horizon.
assessment.attribution_limit: Observation rollout error combines decoder approximation and accumulated transition drift; results do not prove that the frozen representation is fundamentally non-Markovian.
assessment.next_suggestion_not_executed: Test a separately authorized multi-step transition-only objective with encoder/decoder frozen before joint representation learning.

tracked_branch_suite_plus_new_tests.skip_reason: Optional desktop X11 Viewer test requires MINE_UAV_GUI_TEST=1; offline experiment needs no Viewer.

completion_checks.independent_read_only_verify: 8 checks passed; all actual metrics, manifests, hashes, validation selections and checkpoint reloads reproduced
completion_checks.read_only_review: No important defects or blockers; pending artifact/results checks closed by real verification and visual QA.

generation_config.input_convention: pre-command obs7 + previous executed normalized action4

dataset.transition_rule: o_t=inputs[t,:7], a_t=actions[t], next=inputs[t+1,:7]; within episode only
dataset.previous_action_rule: inputs[t,7:11] = executed normalized action at t-1; reset=0

transition.architecture:
ResidualTransition(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=68, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
  )
)
transition.optimizer: independent Adam defaults lr=.001, betas=.9/.999 eps=1e-8; no gradient clipping
transition.order_rule: default_rng(0).permutation(complete Train episode count), reset for each learner

decoder.architecture:
ObservationDecoder(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=7, bias=True)
  )
)
decoder.optimizer: independent Adam defaults lr=.001, betas=.9/.999 eps=1e-8; no gradient clipping
decoder.order_rule: default_rng(0).permutation(complete Train episode count), reset for each learner

encoder.teacher_rule: z[t] includes current observation and previous action, sequential frozen encoder from episode reset

provenance.frame_rule: all saved observation frames; includes final saved frame of each episode

windows.protocol: all starts t in range(max(0,N-H+1)), per episode

pi_magnitude_bins.rule: Train transition PI norm tertiles; small<q1, q1<=medium<q2, large>=q2

transition_objective: MSE(predicted Delta normalized latent, (teacher z[t+1]-teacher z[t])/Train latent std); no observation/PI/reward loss
decoder_objective: MSE(D(normalized teacher z[t]), (current recorded observation-Train obs mean)/Train obs std); independent of transition
residual_rule: z_hat_next = z_hat_current + Train latent std * T(normalized current latent,normalized recorded current action)
protocol: initial teacher z[t] from true prefix; thereafter T-only latent propagation, D readout; no future observation or GRU feedback

1.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

5.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

10.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

25.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

50.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

decoder_reconstruction.frame_rule: D(teacher z[t]) -> current recorded observation[t], all saved frames

selected_window.rule: first Test episode eligible for max horizon; midpoint legal start, no performance selection

limitations: Single seed/nominal recorded actions; no policy or planning evaluation.
Teacher encoder latent is not physical ground-truth state; same frozen coordinates throughout.
Independent one-step T and reconstruction D; no multi-step/joint optimization or encoder adaptation.
Observation rollout error includes both transition and decoder errors; representation may omit dynamics variables.
Raw wrapped-yaw observation convention unchanged; no new circular residual metric or clipping.
